g.text: Bus widths, clock frequencies and lane rates are shown for the default configuration cfg1 (8B10B). SYNC exists only in 8B10B mode.
In general: 128b = L × 8 × TPL_DATAPATH_WIDTH (4 for 8B10B, 8 for 64B66B); 4×32b = L × 32b (8B10B) or L × 64b (64B66B);
link_clk = Lane Rate/40 (8B10B) or Lane Rate/66 (64B66B).
